summary: Planned European database outage means the NOTAM office cannot issue notices for EGTT, EGPX and EGGX; only time-critical notices will be sent.
text:
THE NOTAM OFFICE WILL BE UNABLE TO ISSUE NOTAM/SNOWTAM DUE TO A 
PLANNED EUROPEAN AIS DATABASE (EAD) OUTAGE. DURING THIS OUTAGE, ONLY 
TIME CRITICAL NOTAM/SNOWTAM WILL BE TRANSMITTED AS AN X SERIES 
NOTAM/SNOWTAM IF SENT TO EGGNYNYX.
